messages:
Ravi: Hey team, first-day question. M1 Pro laptop shipped from reseller. Kandji enrollment UI errors with 'Profile install blocked: device not eligible' and FileVault escrow never appears. macOS shows Sonoma 14.2. Any quick checks before I escalate? @IT Oncall
Maya: welcome! that wording usually means ABM serial mismatch or the reseller didn't add the device to our Apple Business Manager. Share the serial and a screenshot.
Ravi: Serial G0P5Q2X8Y1Z7. Screenshot sent. I also ran the Kandji agent debug and saw: "EnrollRequest: 422 - serial not recognized by ABM"
IT Oncall: thanks. 422 is different from the usual 403. 422 likely means ABM knows of the device but there's a device state mismatch (e.g., already claimed by another org or assigned to user instead of device). We'll check ABM and the reseller ticket. Meanwhile, try re-running enrollment after a reboot and confirm you aren't signed into a personal iCloud which can block DEP.
Ravi: I'm signed into personal iCloud because I restored from Time Machine. Oops. Can that block ABM enrollment?
IT Oncall: yes — if Activation Lock is set (iCloud), it prevents automated DEP claiming. Steps: sign out of iCloud, erase the Mac or remove activation lock, then re-run enrol. If you'd rather not erase, we can ask the reseller to release the device in ABM or provide proof to transfer.
Alex: I checked ABM: device G0P5Q2X8Y1Z7 is showing 'Assigned: reseller-temp' with Activation Lock flagged. I opened a support ticket with the reseller to release and set assignment to Redwood. Also I pushed a short Okta elevation for Ravi (45min) in case a local workaround is needed after release.
Kandji Bot: Policy 'onboard-mac-default' pending for device G0P5Q2X8Y1Z7.
IT Oncall: Ravi, if you can sign out of iCloud and erase (we can help remote), that's fastest. If you prefer, keep the machine and we'll coordinate the reseller release; enrollment will succeed once ABM assignment and activation lock are cleared. For Rosetta: that can wait until after enrollment; for now don't install dev tools under your personal account.
Ravi: I signed out of iCloud and did a factory erase via Recovery. Rebooting and trying Kandji enroll now.
Ravi: Enrollment succeeded! Kandji shows 'Enrolled' and FileVault escrow prompt appeared. Escrow completed. Thanks Alex/IT.
Maya: great — welcome aboard Ravi! Tip: if you ever restore from a Time Machine backup before enrollment, sign out of iCloud first to avoid Activation Lock.
Ravi: noted, thanks everyone. Leaving short steps for others: 1) Check iCloud/Activation Lock, 2) Check ABM assignment with IT, 3) request reseller release if needed, 4) erase and retry enroll if comfortable. Saved me a ticket. :tada:
